title: KeyManagerConnectionUpdatedPayload

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

label.description: The new label, when it changed.

address.description: The new address, when it changed.

ca.description: The CA now pinned, when it changed: null for none.

anyOf.description: The CA certificate a connection pins, as PEM (one or more certificates, up to 65536 characters): every request to the key manager verifies its certificate against it, and trusts nothing else.

tokenRole.description: The token role now, when it changed: null for none.

anyOf.description: The token role run tokens are created against: no slash, on one line.

description: key-manager.connection.updated: a connection's label, address, CA or token role changed; each field present only when it did.
